description: Moves files from one Drive folder into subfolders by type (Documents, Spreadsheets, Presentations, Images, PDFs, Other). Dry-run is on by default.
setup: Create a script project and copy in Code.gs and appsscript.json.
Run organizeDriveFolder() once and check the execution log (dry run).
Set DRY_RUN to false only when the log looks right, then run it again.
title: Drive File Organizer
